garch.information_rule: forecast for t+1 is fit using returns observed through trading session t only
garch.risk_reference: expanding median of GARCH one-step volatility forecasts strictly prior to t

transaction_cost.description: 10 bps per unit change in position

simulation.benchmark: CSI 300 next-session simple return derived with expm1 from stored log return

interpretation_guardrails: GARCH is a risk overlay, not a source of directional alpha.
The simulation uses genuine saved OOS directional probabilities only.
No model, threshold, transaction cost, or GARCH parameter is tuned on 2025 or 2026 simulation outcomes.
Active total return is a descriptive difference from benchmark cumulative return, not Jensen alpha.
Simulation results are not live-trading evidence.
